evals.prompt: 上传一张浅蓝色模具布丁照片，顶部有白色奶油和红色樱桃，做成这个极简小人海报。
evals.expected_output: Preserve the molded blue pudding rather than reinterpreting it as another dessert.
expectations: Subject category remains pudding.
Fluted molded silhouette remains recognizable.
Blue smooth/glossy material is preserved.
Defining cream and cherry remain when visible.

evals.prompt: 小人要极简、圆头、无表情、无服饰。
evals.expected_output: All workers use one primitive faceless figure identity.
expectations: Blank round or slightly irregular heads.
No facial features, hair, hats, or clothing details.
White empty interior and uneven thin black outline.
No mascot, badge, logo, or polished character styling.

evals.prompt: 小人不要火柴人，也不要大头矮胖Q版，要像参考图里那种轻巧的圆头极简小人。
evals.expected_output: Workers sit between chibi and stick-figure extremes.
expectations: Total figure height is about 2.8–3.5 head diameters.
Head is about 28%–35% of total figure height.
Torso width is about 55%–75% of head diameter.
Torso is lightly rounded but not barrel-shaped.
Arms and legs are slim and short-to-medium.
Workers are neither fat/chibi nor long-limbed adult stick figures.

evals.prompt: 小人不要抢产品主体，保持微缩比例。
evals.expected_output: Workers remain clearly miniature relative to the hero product.
expectations: Normal worker height is about 12%–18% of hero subject height.
Preferred average is around 14%–16%.
No worker exceeds 20% of hero height without explicit request.
Hero product is noticed before any worker.
Workers do not become co-equal focal points.

evals.prompt: 安排四个小人在产品周围工作，道具不要重复。
evals.expected_output: Structural access props remain rare rather than becoming a default motif.
expectations: Default structural-prop count is zero.
Maximum structural-prop count is one per poster.
A ladder/stool appears only when vertical access materially improves the story.
A ladder is not added just because the product is tall.
Ropes, scaffolds, suspended lines, and floating platforms do not appear unless explicitly requested.

evals.prompt: 如果画面确实需要一个梯子，可以有一个，但空间关系一定要成立。
evals.expected_output: At most one ladder is used and it is physically grounded.
expectations: Ladder base visibly rests on the ground plane.
Perspective matches the product scene.
Top contacts a stable surface or product edge when appropriate.
Worker hands/feet visibly connect to the ladder.
Ladder does not float or terminate in empty space.

evals.prompt: 标题写‘清甜下午茶’，字体要稚拙、松散、细黑线手写。
evals.expected_output: Title uses thin black naive handwriting instead of standard typography.
expectations: Exact requested phrase is used.
Character size, tilt, glyph skeleton, and baseline are irregular.
No standard font, rounded cute font, or polished commercial typography.

evals.prompt: 标题写‘焦糖脑袋冲啊’，字形已经对了，但不要像一行排版字，要像人随手写在画面里。
evals.expected_output: The six-character caption is placed as individually handwritten characters with loose spatial rhythm rather than one typeset horizontal line.
expectations: Exact text 焦糖脑袋冲啊 is preserved.
The six characters are split into 2–3 loose spatial clusters.
The full caption is not rendered as one continuous line.
Characters do not share one clean baseline.
Adjacent gaps are visibly unequal.
At least one gap is roughly 1.5–2.5 times another nearby gap.
At least one character is clearly higher or lower than another.
Reading order remains understandable.

evals.prompt: 标题写‘心态放苹’，参考手写散落感，不要整齐四宫格排版。
evals.expected_output: The four characters form a loose staggered two-level composition rather than a perfect 2×2 grid.
expectations: Exact text 心态放苹 is preserved.
Characters use independent x/y positions.
The result is not a perfect 2×2 grid.
Row and column edges do not align neatly.
Spacing and local character scale vary.
Reading order remains clear.

evals.prompt: 字形已经像手写了，但间距还是像电脑排版，产品和构图不要动。
evals.expected_output: Use fidelity_focus=lettering and repair only character placement rhythm while preserving the accepted poster base and glyph style.
expectations: Poster base stays unchanged.
Only lettering layer is regenerated or repositioned.
Characters are re-placed independently rather than rewritten as one phrase.
Shared baseline is broken.
Adjacent gaps become visibly unequal.
Exact wording and reading order remain intact.

evals.prompt: 主体是冰镇西瓜，做4到5个小人在上面工作。
evals.expected_output: Each worker action maps to a watermelon feature rather than filling space.
expectations: Hydration maps to tending/watering.
Seeds map to collecting/carrying.
Ripeness maps to inspection.
Eating maps to scooping.
Random waving or unrelated decoration is rejected.

evals.prompt: 照片背景里还有书、餐具和其他甜品，只要把主甜品做成海报。
evals.expected_output: Preserve the selected hero and remove unrelated clutter.
expectations: Only identified hero is the main subject.
Unrelated environment is removed or heavily simplified.
Strong white negative space returns.

evals.prompt: 用Fidelity Mode做这张复杂照片，强调画面中最大的有意义元素。
evals.expected_output: Use fidelity_focus=dominant_element and emphasize the largest meaningful subject element.
expectations: Background architecture is not selected merely because it occupies more pixels.
Focus becomes first photographic signal.
Secondary cues stay visually weaker.
Workers remain small relative to the focus element.

evals.prompt: 我给你三张照片，分别用Fidelity Mode做三张独立海报。
evals.expected_output: Treat each source as an independent generation case.
expectations: Three sources produce three independent posters.
No cross-image object leakage.
Comparison board appears only when explicitly requested.
